gpu_tip: ~72GB total at 128K context. An i-quant: strong quality per byte at 3-bit, at the cost of more CPU work per token, so it runs best on CUDA/ROCm with as many layers on the GPU as fit. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 96GB DDR5 kit runs it via expert offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~72GB — too much for a 64GB MacBook Pro; a 96GB config (M4 Max/M5 Max) runs it comfortably.
